rounds: I’d take a pill that let me live to 120.
Families, not care homes, should look after elderly relatives.
Gap years make more sense in your sixties than in your twenties.
Money for anti-ageing research would be better spent on curing diseases.
Health systems should pay for treatments that slow down ageing.
Grandparents should be paid for looking after their grandchildren.
The best years of your life come after fifty.
I’d happily share a flat with someone over 70.
